messages:
maya: Quick proposal: phased compat-shim + customer cutover incentives to reduce migration friction for model catalog changes. short ask: align on gating metrics, rollout cohorts, and incentive bands by EOW.

oliver: can you summarize the shim surface? is this a runtime adapter or a model-level compatibility layer? also what's the minimum adoption % we consider success?

maya: runtime adapter + small model-layer glue. goal is transparent fallback + token-preserving inputs so customers see minimal quality regression. success metric proposal: 60% of active tenants migrate within 8 weeks of offer, <2% increase in error-rate for migrated traffic, latency delta <= +10% p95. open to adjust.

sanjay: technical note: runtime shim will handle tokenizer normalization, input schema mapping, and a compatibility scoring pass. KV cache alignment is tricky — shim may increase cold-start token cost. expect ~3-8% token-rate overhead unless we do prefix normalization caching. need to choose tradeoff.

eva: benchmark gating: we need a curated eval set per tenant cohort (gold prompts + edge-cases). propose two thresholds: quality pass (no >5% drop on critical intents) and regressions flagged per-prompt. also add automatic rollback if customer-visible QA fails during canary.

carol: from sales: three enterprise customers already asked for a smoother migration path. incentives: 6 weeks of credit scaled by usage tier + fast-path migration support. must confirm legal ok with credits. customers prefer deterministic cutover windows.

maya: proposed rollout (high level):
```
phase 0 - pilot (weeks 0-2): 3 internal tenants + 1 friendly customer, smoke tests, observability hooks
phase 1 - cohort A (weeks 3-6): 20 customers (low-risk), incentive = 2 weeks credit
phase 2 - cohort B (weeks 7-10): 100 customers (medium risk), incentive = 4 weeks credit
phase 3 - general (weeks 11-14): opt-in window + grace TTL for pinned versions, incentive = 6 weeks credit for first movers
```

maya: notes: each phase gated by benchmark pass + SLO telemetry (latency/errs/regression rate). need explicit rollback plan and a compatibility fallback route to previous pinned model per-tenant.

sanjay: +1 on rollback route. implementation idea: route-level annotation for pin overrides + automatic fallback when p95 latency > target or regression alerts exceed threshold. question: do we allow partial pin (e.g., embeddings vs. generation) per-tenant?

eva: prefer per-route granularity for visibility. evaluation infra must produce per-route deltas. add monitoring hooks: "compat_regressions", "latency_delta_pct", "migration_uptake_rate".

oliver: what do we need from product to greenlight? my list: 1) final benchmark thresholds, 2) incentive bands + legal ok, 3) pilot customer list, 4) rollout comms draft.

maya: i'll own comms + pilot list. @carol can you confirm customers and send to legal? @sanjay can you prototype shim and a perf smoke test by next Tue? @eva can you assemble eval sets for pilot tenants?

carol: will reach out to customers today and loop in legal.

sanjay: prototyping timeline seems fine. will post infra notes in eng-runtime channel and attach perf numbers.

rollout-bot: scheduled reminder set: "compat-shim greenlight review" at 1745760000.

maya: ok — decision checkpoint scheduled EOW. if no blockers, we'll proceed with pilot the following week. :rocket:
